notes: Current MCP transport for Pandora is stdio.
The local backend expects a compatible `pandora` CLI binary on PATH unless the caller overrides command/args.
Use the local MCP stdio backend for same-machine execution.
Cold agents should prefer the canonical bootstrap surface before lower-level capabilities/schema discovery.
Compatibility aliases are available only through the explicit contractRegistry.compatibility surface.
Generated SDK catalogs default to canonical-only command and tool surfaces.
Generated TypeScript and Python SDK alpha packages are shipped in this build under sdk/typescript and sdk/python.
Remote streamable HTTP MCP gateway is shipped in this build but inactive until `pandora mcp http` is running.
Use the remote MCP streamable HTTP backend against a running `pandora mcp http` gateway.

implementation.implemented: Executable backend code path exists in the current runtime.
implementation.placeholder: Profile/backend metadata ships for planning, but the executable backend is not implemented yet.

runtime.degraded: Implemented backend exists, but the current runtime is missing signer material, network context, or execution compatibility prerequisites.
runtime.placeholder: Backend is still a placeholder in the current runtime and cannot become ready yet.
runtime.ready: Implemented backend plus current runtime prerequisites are satisfied for at least one shipped built-in profile.
runtime.unknown: Current runtime could not derive readiness for this backend from built-in profiles.

notes: Mirror go inherits the exact market payload from its deploy stage; use the returned validation ticket from paper/dry-run output.
When mirror go will execute a fresh deploy, provide independent public --sources and a matching validation ticket.
Run agent.market.validate on that exact payload before rerunning mirror.go with execute or execute-live.
Validation tickets are bound to the exact final deploy payload. Any change to question, rules, sources, target timestamp, liquidity, fee params, or distribution requires a fresh validation pass.

For AMM deploy/go flows, prefer --initial-yes-pct/--initial-no-pct to set the opening probability directly. Use --yes-reserve-weight-pct/--no-reserve-weight-pct only for explicit reserve-weight control.
Legacy --distribution-yes-pct/--distribution-no-pct are rejected with a migration error because they were ambiguous for AMM pricing.
Private-routing flags affect only the Ethereum Pandora rebalance leg. They do not make the Polygon hedge leg atomic.

mirror.go.name: mirror.go

notes: Mirror go inherits the exact market payload from its deploy stage; use the returned validation ticket from paper/dry-run output.
When mirror go will execute a fresh deploy, provide independent public --sources and a matching validation ticket.
Run agent.market.validate on that exact payload before rerunning mirror.go with execute or execute-live.
Validation tickets are bound to the exact final deploy payload. Any change to question, rules, sources, target timestamp, liquidity, fee params, or distribution requires a fresh validation pass.

For AMM deploy/go flows, prefer --initial-yes-pct/--initial-no-pct to set the opening probability directly. Use --yes-reserve-weight-pct/--no-reserve-weight-pct only for explicit reserve-weight control.
Legacy --distribution-yes-pct/--distribution-no-pct are rejected with a migration error because they were ambiguous for AMM pricing.
Private-routing flags affect only the Ethereum Pandora rebalance leg. They do not make the Polygon hedge leg atomic.

Long-running execution remains blocked in MCP v1, and live mutation requires intent.execute with execute or execute-live.

adopt-existing-positions.description: Seed managed Polymarket inventory from existing live YES/NO balances before sell-side recycling.

drift-trigger-bps.description: Drift trigger in basis points.

execute.description: Execute live/write path.

flashbots-auth-key.description: Optional Flashbots auth key or signer reference for the Ethereum Pandora rebalance leg.

flashbots-relay-url.description: Optional Flashbots/private relay URL for the Ethereum Pandora rebalance leg.

flashbots-target-block-offset.description: Optional target block offset for Flashbots/private bundle submission.

hedge-scope.description: Hedge basis. total includes held Pandora outcome tokens in addition to pool reserves; pool hedges only the AMM reserves.

hedge-trigger-usdc.description: Hedge trigger size in USDC.

execute.description: Set true to permit live/mutating execution when supported by the tool.

polymarket-rpc-url.description: Polygon RPC URL for Polymarket preflight; comma-separated fallbacks are tried in order. This does not override Pandora reserve reads on --rpc-url.

price-source.description: Reserve source for Pandora pricing. on-chain refreshes outcome-token balances before sizing; indexer uses verify payload reserves.

profile-file.description: Path to a signer profile file.

rebalance-mode.description: Rebalance sizing mode. atomic targets the source price in one Pandora leg when reserves are available; incremental sizes by observed drift.

rebalance-route.description: Pandora-leg execution route. public preserves ordinary mempool submission; auto chooses a private route when supported; flashbots-private requests single-tx private relay submission; flashbots-bundle requests Flashbots bundle semantics for approval+trade paths. This affects only the Ethereum Pandora leg.

rebalance-route-fallback.description: Fallback policy when the requested Pandora-leg private route is unsupported or rejected. fail stops the run; public degrades to ordinary public submission. This does not change Polygon hedge semantics.

skip-gate.description: Set to "true" to skip all mirror sync gates, or provide a comma-delimited named skip list.

skip-initial-hedge.description: Capture the startup hedge gap as a baseline and only hedge later delta changes. This does not change the meaning of hedge-scope.

strict-close-time-delta.description: Promote close-time delta mismatches from diagnostic to blocking.

notes: The default mirror stop file is ~/.pandora/mirror/STOP. Its presence intentionally blocks local mirror sync starts and ticks until cleared.
Use mirror.panic clear mode after incident review, or remove the stop file manually only if you know the emergency lock is stale.
